name: DJ MATIK
body: My Brother Pauly Danger very humble , always showed love and support to his fellow DJ brothers . You will be missed Paul . Thanks for the advice and good talks about the music always . We never got to link up so I can give you that soca music . Until we meet again respect brother never change or switch up . It was a pleasure being able to DJ with you . Thanks for coming to my events and showing love 🫶🏽👊🏾✊🏾
